traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 genus aggregate for Spiraea (gwddagg_v2.2_genus.csv, read): specific gravity 0.69 (wsg_est, the hierarchical-model genus mean, from 46 records in 2 sources); trunks 0.69, branches 0.64. A species with its own measurements states its own. Basic density is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

traits.inflorescence.note: The Flora of North America's account of the genus, as quoted in search results (the page itself was not read): inflorescences mostly terminal panicles, corymbiform, conic, cylindric, hemispheric, obconic, pyramidal or pyriform; a few species bear racemiform clusters or reduced fascicles.

traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full: petals ovate; stamens 10 to 50, much exserted; pods commonly 5, in the superior-ovaried tribe Spiraeeae.
